card.name: The word by before a route
card.fires_on: The word "by" right after a thing given, sent or said, when it introduces a method or route such as injection, mouth, email or telephone.

modes.label: Route of administration
modes.description: "by" after a drug, dose or verb like given or taken, before a route such as intravenous, injection or mouth.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Usually 0.25 to 2 mL<< by>> intramuscular or slow intravenous injection

modes.label: Means of communication or delivery
modes.description: "by" after a sent or said item, before a medium such as telephone or email.
modes.example: receive notifications of new posts<< by>> email.

card.plain: It marks the word "by" when it introduces how something is delivered, such as by mouth or by injection.
